protocol.selection: Minimum validation primary loss within each class, then across classes; exact class ties prefer additive, then pairwise; capacity ties prefer fewer leaves
protocol.evaluation: Persist all dataset choices before any test evaluation; evaluate only each class's selected capacity without refitting
protocol.memory_scope: Fit-end RSS includes imports, raw data, preprocessing and fit; retained payload excludes Python object overhead and unknown extension allocations; pickle contains estimator only, adapter state is separate
